cards.title: Borrowed Authority
cards.instruction: Project confident authority while quietly working to keep everyone cooperative. Your confidence depends on their cooperation.

cards.title: Pick the Prize
cards.instruction: Make them choose which reward, principle, or relationship matters most when not everything can be kept.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'd like to keep this voluntary. You can keep the prize money or fund the team trip. Which matters more? Please.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Can't we do a cheaper trip?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'm still in charge; we can make an adjustment. Only if someone adds money. You hold the prize.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'm asking you to choose before everyone else quietly pays for it.

mechanism: A prices the cheapest team trip and moves the decision private while requiring B to choose between keeping prize money and funding it.
confusable: Unlike shaming B for any selfishness, A asks a concrete resource choice under a genuine shortfall.
comparison: Private funding decision and cheapest cost differ from incompatible evening events.
seedUse: D202-b prize and team trip; S02-b does pricing and protects B audience while retaining the priority choice.
